question.text: Dividend income from Indian listed equity is:

answer.text: Taxed at the investor's applicable slab rate as other income

explanation.text: The Logic: Post-FY20-21 Indian Budget, dividends are taxed in investors' hands at slab rate. The Trap: DDT at company level is history. Cross-Exam Context: Same in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: For high-bracket investors, dividend-heavy strategies carry higher tax drag.
